# Vendored runtime

Three.js 0.185.1 (`three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`, `OrbitControls.js`)
is included for an offline/local, dependency-install-free example. These files
are unmodified copies from the Three.js distribution already used for local
verification, not new geometry or a manufacturer CAD kernel. See the preserved
MIT license in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`; the repository's Apache-2.0 declaration does
not replace that third-party license. Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js.
